turnaround_reason: Forward Air destroyed shareholder value with its controversial $2.1B Omni Logistics acquisition in Jan 2024, loading ~$1.4B of extra debt onto the balance sheet. The stock fell from ~$31 to a $7.86 low and is basing near $16 as the board pursues asset sales to deleverage.
bullish_points: Basing well off the $7.86 low; a successful non-core asset sale (Intermodal, Omni units) would be a hard deleveraging catalyst
Core LTL/expedited franchise remains a real, revenue-generating business ($2.5B TTM revenue, +8.8% growth)
Activist and strategic interest has kept a floor of M&A optionality under the name
bearish_points: Full-enterprise sale process ended without a buyer; Clearlake and Apollo walked — the cleanest exit is off the table
Net debt ~$1.68B at 5.5x EBITDA; $2.1B total debt against just $139M cash is a genuinely stressed balance sheet
Q2 2026 operating loss of $201M including a $244M Omni goodwill impairment — the acquisition is still being written down
Negative net margin (-11%); deleveraging via piecemeal asset sales is slow and value-uncertain
catalyst: Announcement of Intermodal and/or Omni non-core asset sales that materially cut leverage
catalyst_timing: Ongoing through 2026 as the strategic review concludes
suggested_trade: Pass / watchlist only. Revisit if a concrete asset-sale price and debt-paydown figure is announced.
key_risk: Leverage at 5.5x with a deteriorating freight cycle — a covenant or refinancing problem could wipe the equity
would_skip_if: You require a clean balance sheet or a committed buyer; both are absent here
